description.value: Swift Creek Cabins are remote backcountry wilderness cabins operated by Headwaters Outfitting near Valemount, BC, sitting in subalpine terrain close to Mount Robson Provincial Park. The self-catered cabins are wood-heated, propane-lit, and designed for small groups pursuing backcountry skiing in winter or alpine hiking in summer. Guests must sign a wilderness release waiver on arrival, reflecting the genuinely remote and rugged nature of the location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Swift Creek Cabins is operated by Headwaters Outfitting alongside Dave Henry Lodge, both located near Valemount, BC. The site focuses entirely on backcountry skiing (winter) and hiking/horse-back riding (summer) at high elevation wilderness settings, with no mention of cycling, bike storage, or any cycling-related amenities. Contact details (phone, email, mailing address) are present on the website but OSM carries no phone or address, so OSM-vs-website cross-check applies only to the website URL.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Swift Creek Cabins is a legitimate, operating wilderness accommodation near Valemount, but the website contains no reference to cycling whatsoever and the cabins are remote backcountry facilities primarily marketed for ski touring and alpine hiking. Inclusion would depend on whether known bikepacking or gravel cycling routes in the Valemount area pass near this location, which cannot be determined from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.notes: Swift Creek Cabins are co-listed with Dave Henry Lodge under the Headwaters Outfitting brand. All booking, contact, and waiver information on the website applies to both properties. Email is davehenrylodge@gmail.com.
